prompt: Call bash twice in the SAME reply, so both run in parallel, with no text before or between them. First call: description "Wait for service A", command: sleep 15 && echo a. Second call: description "Wait for service B", command: sleep 18 && echo b.

steps.until: (?m)^● .*Waiting for service B · \d+s *\n +⎿ +\$ sleep 18 && echo b \([3-9]s\)
(?m)^● .*Waiting for service B · \d+s *\n +⎿ +\$ sleep 18 && echo b \((?:1[0-4])s\)
